items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: this old man used to play... well me give him ideas, what's his name, Albert Glennie?

ctx.x: See somebody told me once about Jimmy Brown and they played with Manuel Perez sometime on bass. Do you remember Jimmy Brown?

I don't remember Jimmy Brown. It must have been before my time. Yeah. I didn't know Jimmy Brown. And then this old man used to play, of course he didn't play no whole lot of bass, but I mean he used to play, well me give him ideas, what's his name, Albert Glennie? Oh yes.
